mapper.select: select id, user_id, agreement_id, agreement_type, agreement_version, accepted_time, accepted_ip from wl_user_agreement where user_id = #{userId} and agreement_id = #{agreementId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct agreement_id) from wl_user_agreement where user_id = #{userId} and agreement_id = #{agreementId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wl_user_agreement(user_id, agreement_id, agreement_type, agreement_version, accepted_time, accepted_ip, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag) values(#{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{agreementType}, #{agreementVersion}, #{acceptedTime}, #{acceptedIp}, 'wx', now(), '', now(), '0')
